items.question: Does this result fix my personality type?
items.answer: No. It is a working interpretation based on this response and should be checked against real situations and continued observation.

items.question: Can E105 and FC144 scores be compared directly?
items.answer: No. They share one Enneagram content model but use different response tasks and scoring spaces.

technical_note.title: Technical Note
technical_note.summary: Explains forms, score spaces, interpretation boundaries, data status, and privacy handling without making diagnostic, hiring, or deterministic personality claims.
